rebuildEvidence.interpretation: The initial user-CARGO_HOME debug executable was rebuilt during the first default-plugin fixture, using the plugin's project-local Cargo home. Rust source/manifest/lock were unchanged.

storeFixture.interpretation: The fixture ran after the plugin-triggered rebuild and used the shared debug-binary path. A contemporaneous hash was not recorded, so exact SHA equality with the later benchmark binary cannot be asserted.

benchmarkBuild.interpretation: The exclusive benchmark build captured this binary hash before and after its build; no Rust source changes occurred between the correctness gate and benchmark build.

limitation: Do not claim all compiler-backed fixtures used the initial hash 24f6155e... or that fixture 12 had a directly recorded 633c4bc... hash. The new Store fixture did run after the rebuild via the explicit shared path; precise historical per-fixture executable bytes were not captured.
